property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner, calling setOwner(_owner) sets C.owner() equal to the provided _owner; the mutant that unconditionally sets owner = address(0) violates this by making owner() == address(0) for some fuzzed _owner values.
change_summary: Replace the assignment in setOwner to set owner to address(0) (zero address) instead of the provided _owner parameter.
